papers.title: ETPNav: Evolving Topological Planning for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.abstract: Public abstract summary: ETPNav builds a topological map online from proposed waypoints and separates route planning from low-level obstacle avoidance in continuous vision-language navigation.

papers.title: JARVIS-1: Open-World Multi-Task Agents With Memory-Augmented Multimodal Language Models
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.abstract: Public abstract summary: JARVIS-1 combines multimodal planning and goal-conditioned control in Minecraft, using memory of past experiences to support longer tasks.

papers.title: Knowledge-Based Embodied Question Answering
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.abstract: Public abstract summary: K-EQA uses neural program synthesis for reasoning over external knowledge and a 3D scene graph. The graph acts as memory of visited scenes for follow-up questions.
